description: This file defines classes and methods related to delivery carriers, delivery grids, and delivery grid lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including price calculation logic based on order details and delivery grid configurations.

classes.name: delivery_carrier
classes.description: Model representing delivery carriers and associated delivery grids, including price calculation based on order and contact details.

classes.name: delivery_grid
classes.description: Model representing delivery grids with pricing logic based on order line totals, weight, and volume.

classes.name: delivery_grid_line
classes.description: Model representing individual lines within a delivery grid, defining conditions and prices for different delivery scenarios.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Calculates the price for a delivery carrier based on the order and contact details.

methods.name: grid_get
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate delivery grid ID based on contact address and carrier.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Calculates the delivery price based on order totals, weight, and volume within a delivery grid.

methods.name: get_price_from_picking
methods.description: Determines the delivery price from grid lines based on calculated order metrics and conditions.
